name: Love For a Beast
source:
Love For a Beast is a gay furry NSFW twist on a classic fairy tale Beauty And the Beast. We follow our protagonist who gets caught in a snow storm and seeks shelter in an enchanted castle where he meets the mysterious beast.  The story is filled with magic, emotional conflict, and a hot hunky wolf husband.

[From [url=https://bearyjack.itch.io/love-for-a-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Love For a Beast》是对经典童话《美女与野兽》的同性恋、毛茸茸的NSFW改编。我们跟随我们的主角，他被暴风雪困住，在一座魔法城堡里寻求庇护，在那里他遇到了神秘的野兽。这个故事充满了魔力、情感冲突和一个火辣的猛狼丈夫。

[来自[url=https://bearyjack.itch.io/love-for-a-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
